messages:
Ana: Quick sync — launching paid push for 'Scholar Series: Deep Dive' on Wed 4/14. Need search + retarget plan, creative refresh, and inbound routing. 30k budget over 7 days. Thoughts?

Mike: +1. Proposed split: 60% search, 30% retarget, 10% discovery. Daily cap ~ $4.3k. Use broad match + RLSA for retarget audiences. Will set initial CPA goal at $45.

Rachel: For creative, rotate 3 headlines and 2 CTAs. Test hero image vs no-image and a short 15s clip for retarget. I'll upload specs to the creative drive and drop a brief by EOD. :paintbrush:

Sam: Routing note — all webinar signups -> HubSpot form `ws_scholar_0414` then webhook -> #leads-inbound. Plan is to tag source=paid_scholar and send high-intent leads to Sales queue via API. Will confirm field mapping.

Ana: Linking the UTM pattern we should use across channels: `?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=scholar_deepdive_0414&utm_term={keyword}` — please use that verbatim so analytics lines up.

AdOpsBot: Automated: Campaign 'scholar_deepdive_search' created (ID: 98123). Draft budget set: 30000 USD, start=1769999000, end=1770603800.

Mike: Pacing rule: if spend <70% of daily target by day 3, trigger a retarget burst with +15% bids on top 10 audiences and swap to creative variant B. Also set a hard daily cap to avoid overspend.

Rachel: No objections. I'll prepare variant B (image + 15s video) and include headline permutations. Quick Q: prefer 'Deep Dive' or 'Product Deep Dive' in messaging? Leaning shorter.

Ana: Prefer shorter — go with 'Deep Dive'. We'll iterate in messaging tests.

Sam: On routing: I'll add a webhook that posts to #leads-inbound and to the HubSpot queue. For high-intent detection, use field `engagement_score >= 3` or presence of job_title + company. Will document in runbook.

Mike: Small note on retargeting windows — 7/14/30 day audiences. Start with 14-day for highest bid, 30-day with lower bid.

Rachel: I'll version creatives as A/B/C and include the tracking pixel snippet in the landing templates.

Ana: Action items: Rachel — creatives by EOD Tue; Mike — campaign build + pacing rules + bid scripts; Sam — routing + webhook + runbook entries. Check-in Tue 10:30am. Ping me if blockers. :spiral_calendar:
